text: DS Bot Mobile Bridge 是连接电脑端 DSH 与现有 DS Bot 团队的原生手机 App 传输插件。它在 DSH 中注册移动端服务和电脑所有者管理接口，经设备配对后提供 Bot 与群会话发现、分页文字历史、消息提交与回执、WebSocket 消息更新，以及宿主声明支持时的模型、用量、记忆、日程和队列操作。适合希望从手机继续访问现有团队会话的用户；需要兼容 Bridge 接口的 DS Bot、独立状态目录和可由手机访问的 HTTPS 服务地址，不需要额外模型 API Key。

DS Bot Mobile Bridge lets a native phone app access an existing DS Bot team through DSH. Paired devices can browse conversations, read text history, send messages, check receipts, and receive live updates. Requires a compatible host, dedicated storage, and HTTPS access; no model API key.
想用手机查看电脑上现有 DS Bot 团队里的 Bot 和群会话。
能不能在手机上翻页阅读 DSH 会话的文字历史？
我想从手机给现有 Bot 发消息，并确认消息有没有提交成功。
怎样把手机配对到电脑上的 DSH，并由电脑批准或撤销设备？
I want to continue reading my existing DS Bot conversations from a native phone app.
Can I send a message from my phone and check its submission receipt?
**DS Bot Mobile Bridge** 的功能「手机设备配对」：电脑端创建配对码，手机提交配对请求后由电脑所有者批准；批准后发放设备会话凭据，并可在电脑端撤销设备。
**DS Bot Mobile Bridge** 的功能「浏览会话并接收更新」：配对设备可发现可见 Bot／群会话、按游标分页读取文字历史，并通过 WebSocket 跟随会话消息与状态更新。
**DS Bot Mobile Bridge** 的功能「提交消息与查看回执」：手机提交纯文本消息时携带请求标识；Bridge 将请求交给兼容宿主，并提供回执查询和重复请求的稳定处理。

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · DS Bot Mobile Bridge：当前版本为 **0.0.6 独立插件预览**，适配 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** 与提供兼容 Bridge 接口的 DS Bot。这里维护传输服务；手机界面和电脑上的配对管理界面由 App 仓库维护。仅用手机浏览器时，请安装 [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web)，无需 Bridge。

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · 架构：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  App[手机原生 App] -->|HTTPS／设备凭据| Bridge[Mobile Bridge]
  Owner[电脑 App 配套插件] -->|DSH 所有者认证| Bridge
  Bridge -->|公开会话接口| Team[现有 DS Bot 团队]

Bridge 与电脑管理界面独立启停。手机只能访问协商后明确支持的能力，电脑所有者负责批准与撤销设备；团队、Bot 和群会话继续由 DS Bot 管理。

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · 能力与边界：| 能力 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 设备配对 | 请求经电脑批准后发放可撤销的设备凭据 |
| 会话与历史 | 可见 Bot／群、分页文字历史、完整消息与重连状态 |
| 稳定提交 | 请求标识、回执查询和冲突重试拒绝 |
| 受限操作 | 按宿主声明提供模型、用量、自己的记忆、日程、队列和取消 |
| 数据边界 | 明确字段投影、群会话作用域与上游已知值脱敏 |

本版不提供逐 token 事件、原生审批或密钥提交、媒体与语音传输、系统推送或群管理。完整能力取决于兼容宿主，详见[兼容说明](COMPATIBILITY.md)。

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · 安装与配对：1. **确认宿主兼容。** 现有 DS Bot 需要 `bridge.describe`、稳定 `bridge.submit` 和 `bridge.redact`。原版 npm DS Bot `0.1.7` 缺少完整接口；需要时使用 [App 发布页](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app/releases)明确标识的兼容包。
2. **安装 Bridge。** 从 [Bridge Releases](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/releases) 下载 `.tgz` 插件包，在电脑的 DSH 官方插件管理器安装、启用。
3. **配置独立状态与 HTTPS。** 按[配置指南](docs/configuration.md)设置专用绝对 `home`、监听端口和已有的手机可达 HTTPS 地址。Bridge 不创建隧道、证书或公网入口。
4. **扫码并批准。** 安装 App 配套插件，从电脑 **手机访问 → App** 生成配对码；手机扫描后，在电脑核对设备名称并批准。
ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · 安装与配对：`.tgz` 安装在电脑上。手机需要 App 仓库提供的原生客户端；目前仍需自行构建，没有公开可直接安装的 IPA/APK。扫码不会自动得到设备权限。

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · 三个独立组件：| 仓库 | 职责 | 什么时候需要 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web) | 浏览器界面、会话导航、Web 登录入口 | 手机直接用浏览器访问 |
| [Mobile App](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app) | 原生客户端、SDK、电脑配对与设备管理界面 | 使用原生 App |
| **Mobile Bridge** | 设备认证、受限会话访问、HTTP／WebSocket 传输 | 原生 App 连接电脑 |
ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · 更新与迁移：保留原 Bridge `home`，其中保存设备与回执身份。先停用旧实例并释放端口，再用同一状态目录启用新包；不要让两个实例同时使用同一目录。停用 App 配套插件只移除管理界面；要停止设备传输，应停用 Bridge。要撤销某台手机，在电脑的已授权设备列表中撤销访问。

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · DS Bot Mobile Bridge：Mobile Bridge is an independent computer-side [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin for [DS Bot Mobile App](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app). It provides device pairing, scoped authorization, Bot/group text history, message submission and receipts through the existing team's public session APIs.

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · DS Bot Mobile Bridge：The current independent plugin preview is **0.0.6**, targeting DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** and a DS Bot installation that provides the compatible Bridge contract. The App repository owns the phone client and computer-side pairing interface. For phone browser access, use [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web); Bridge is unnecessary.

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Architecture：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  App[Native Mobile App] -->|HTTPS and device credentials| Bridge[Mobile Bridge]
  Owner[App companion in DSH] -->|authenticated owner carrier| Bridge
  Bridge -->|public Session APIs| Team[Existing DS Bot team]

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Capabilities：- Pair devices after explicit computer-owner approval; revoke credentials when needed.
- List visible Bots and groups, read paginated text history, receive full messages and recover after reconnecting.
- Submit text using a stable request identity and query receipts; conflicting retries are refused.
- Negotiate explicitly declared model, usage, own-memory, schedule, queue and cancellation operations.
- Project bounded metadata and group history through the upstream known-value redaction contract.

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Capabilities：Token-level events, native approval/secret submission, media/voice transport, system push and group administration are outside this release. See [compatibility](COMPATIBILITY.md).

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Install and pair：1. Confirm that DS Bot exposes `bridge.describe`, stable `bridge.submit`, and `bridge.redact`. Pristine npm DS Bot `0.1.7` lacks the complete contract. A separately identified compatible package is available through [App releases](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app/releases).
2. Download the plugin `.tgz` from [Bridge Releases](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/releases), then install and enable it in your existing DSH plugin manager on the computer.
3. Configure a dedicated persistent absolute `home`, listener and existing phone-accessible HTTPS endpoint. Follow [configuration](docs/configuration.md); Bridge does not provision tunnels, certificates or a new team.
4. Install the App companion. Open **Phone access → App** on the computer, scan its pairing QR in the native client, then verify and approve the pending device on the computer.

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Install and pair：The `.tgz` belongs on the computer. The native phone client remains a self-built source preview; ready-to-install public IPA/APK files are unavailable. Scanning alone does not authorize a device.

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Independent components：| Repository | Responsibility | Required for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Mobile Web](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-web) | Browser layout, navigation and Web sign-in | Browser access |
| [Mobile App](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app) | Native client, SDK and computer pairing interface | Native App access |
| **Mobile Bridge** | Device authentication and scoped HTTP/WebSocket transport | Native App access |

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Updates：Preserve the original Bridge `home` to retain device and receipt identity. Stop the old instance before starting another against the same directory or port. Disabling the companion removes its interface; disabling Bridge stops device transport. Revoke a lost device from the computer's authorized-device list.

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Capabilities：Token-level events, native approval/secret submission, media/voice transport, system push and group administration are outside this release. See [compatibility](COMPATIBILITY.md).

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Install and pair：1. Confirm that DS Bot exposes `bridge.describe`, stable `bridge.submit`, and `bridge.redact`. Pristine npm DS Bot `0.1.7` lacks the complete contract. A separately identified compatible package is available through [App releases](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-app/releases).
2. Download the plugin `.tgz` from [Bridge Releases](https://github.com/MuQY1818/ds-bot-mobile-bridge/releases), then install and enable it in your existing DSH plugin manager on the computer.
3. Configure a dedicated persistent absolute `home`, listener and existing phone-accessible HTTPS endpoint. Follow [configuration](docs/configuration.md); Bridge does not provision tunnels, certificates or a new team.
4. Install the App companion. Open **Phone access → App** on the computer, scan its pairing QR in the native client, then verify and approve the pending device on the computer.

ds-bot-mobile-bridge README · Install and pair：The `.tgz` belongs on the computer. The native phone client remains a self-built source preview; ready-to-install public IPA/APK files are unavailable. Scanning alone does not authorize a device.
